entries.declaration_header: theorem kernel_nonzero_ae (K : 𝓢(ℝ,ℝ)) : ∀ᵐ x ∂measure K, K x≠0
theorem drift_density (K : 𝓢(ℝ,ℝ)) (x : ℝ) : |K x| * drift K x=2*K x*deriv K x
theorem drift_memLp_top (K : 𝓢(ℝ,ℝ)) : MemLp (drift K) ∞ (measure K)

theorem distributionEmbedding_injective (K : 𝓢(ℝ,ℝ)) :
    Function.Injective (distributionEmbedding K)
theorem embed_injective (K : 𝓢(ℝ,ℝ)) : Function.Injective (embed K)

theorem distributionEmbedding_apply (K : 𝓢(ℝ,ℝ)) (u : H K) (g : 𝓢(ℝ,ℂ)) :
    distributionEmbedding K u g = ∫ x : ℝ, g x*u x ∂measure K

theorem embed_apply (K : 𝓢(ℝ,ℝ)) (u : H K) (g : 𝓢(ℝ,ℂ)) :
    embed K u g = ∫ x : ℝ, g x*((|K x|:ℝ):ℂ)*u x ∂measure K

theorem driftEmbedding_apply (K : 𝓢(ℝ,ℝ)) (u : H K) (g : 𝓢(ℝ,ℂ)) :
    driftEmbedding K u g = ∫ x : ℝ, g x*(drift K x:ℂ)*u x ∂measure K

theorem embed_schwartz (K : 𝓢(ℝ,ℝ)) (f g : 𝓢(ℝ,ℂ)) :
    embed K (f.toLp 2 (measure K)) g = ∫ x : ℝ, g x*f x*(K x:ℂ)^2

theorem driftEmbedding_schwartz (K : 𝓢(ℝ,ℝ)) (f g : 𝓢(ℝ,ℂ)) :
    driftEmbedding K (f.toLp 2 (measure K)) g =
      ∫ x : ℝ, g x*f x*(2*(K x:ℂ)*((deriv K x:ℝ):ℂ))

theorem testWeight_apply (K : 𝓢(ℝ,ℝ)) (g : 𝓢(ℝ,ℂ)) (x : ℝ) :
    testWeight K g x = (K x:ℂ)^2*g x

theorem testWeight_deriv (K : 𝓢(ℝ,ℝ)) (g : 𝓢(ℝ,ℂ)) (x : ℝ) :
    deriv (testWeight K g) x =
      2*(K x:ℂ)*((deriv K x:ℝ):ℂ)*g x+(K x:ℂ)^2*deriv g x

theorem core_identity (K : 𝓢(ℝ,ℝ)) (f : 𝓢(ℝ,ℂ)) :
    embed K ((SchwartzMap.derivCLM ℂ ℂ f).toLp 2 (measure K)) =
      TemperedDistribution.derivCLM ℂ (embed K (f.toLp 2 (measure K))) -
        driftEmbedding K (f.toLp 2 (measure K))

theorem weakGraph_mem (K : 𝓢(ℝ,ℝ)) (u v : H K) : (u,v) ∈ weakGraph K ↔
    embed K v = TemperedDistribution.derivCLM ℂ (embed K u) - driftEmbedding K u

theorem weakGraph_singleValued (K : 𝓢(ℝ,ℝ)) (p : H K × H K)
    (hp : p ∈ weakGraph K) (hz : p.1=0) : p.2=0
theorem weakDerivative_graph (K : 𝓢(ℝ,ℝ)) : (weakDerivative K).graph=weakGraph K
theorem weakGraph_closed (K : 𝓢(ℝ,ℝ)) : IsClosed (weakGraph K : Set (H K × H K))
theorem weakDerivative_closed (K : 𝓢(ℝ,ℝ)) : (weakDerivative K).IsClosed

theorem core_mem_weakGraph (K : 𝓢(ℝ,ℝ)) (f : 𝓢(ℝ,ℂ)) :
    (coreInput K f, coreDerivative K f) ∈ weakGraph K
theorem coreGraph_le_weakGraph (K : 𝓢(ℝ,ℝ)) : coreGraph K ≤ weakGraph K
theorem coreOperator_graph (K : 𝓢(ℝ,ℝ)) : (coreOperator K).graph=coreGraph K
theorem coreOperator_le_weakDerivative (K : 𝓢(ℝ,ℝ)) : coreOperator K ≤ weakDerivative K

theorem coreOperator_dense_domain (K : 𝓢(ℝ,ℝ)) :
    Dense ((coreOperator K).domain : Set (H K))
theorem coreOperator_closable (K : 𝓢(ℝ,ℝ)) : (coreOperator K).IsClosable
theorem closedDerivative_closed (K : 𝓢(ℝ,ℝ)) : (closedDerivative K).IsClosed

theorem closedDerivative_dense_domain (K : 𝓢(ℝ,ℝ)) :
    Dense ((closedDerivative K).domain : Set (H K))

theorem closedDerivative_le_weakDerivative (K : 𝓢(ℝ,ℝ)) :
    closedDerivative K ≤ weakDerivative K

theorem schwartz_mem_closed_graph (K : 𝓢(ℝ,ℝ)) (f : 𝓢(ℝ,ℂ)) :
    (coreInput K f, coreDerivative K f) ∈ (closedDerivative K).graph

theorem core_seqClosable (K : 𝓢(ℝ,ℝ)) :
    WeightedFormClosability.SeqClosable (coreInput K).toLinearMap (coreDerivative K).toLinearMap

theorem core_formClosable (K : 𝓢(ℝ,ℝ)) (κ : ℝ) (hκ : 0 ≤ κ) :
    WeightedFormClosability.FormClosable κ (coreInput K).toLinearMap (coreDerivative K).toLinearMap
theorem adjoint_closed (K : 𝓢(ℝ,ℝ)) : (closedDerivative K).adjoint.IsClosed

theorem higherHeatDerivative_dense_closed (m : ℕ) (hm : 0 < m) (t : ℝ≥0) (ht : 0 < t) :
    Dense ((higherHeatDerivative m hm t ht).domain :
      Set (H (HigherHeatSignedLaws.realKernel m hm t ht))) ∧
      (higherHeatDerivative m hm t ht).IsClosed

theorem counterexample_still_closable :
    (coreOperator NormalizedSignedScoreCounterexample.normalized).IsClosable ∧
      ¬ MemLp (fun x : ℝ => (SignedSchwartzLogDerivative.score
        NormalizedSignedScoreCounterexample.normalized x:ℂ)) 2
        (SignedSchwartzL2Rigging.measure NormalizedSignedScoreCounterexample.normalized)

theorem probe_pairing (K : 𝓢(ℝ,ℝ)) (g : 𝓢(ℝ,ℂ)) (u : H K) :
    inner ℝ (probe K g) u = (embed K u g).re

theorem image_pairing (K : 𝓢(ℝ,ℝ)) (g : 𝓢(ℝ,ℂ)) (u : H K) :
    inner ℝ (image K g) u =
      -(embed K u (SchwartzMap.derivCLM ℂ ℂ g)).re - (driftEmbedding K u g).re

theorem weak_pairing (K : 𝓢(ℝ,ℝ)) (u v : H K) (h : (u,v) ∈ weakGraph K) (g : 𝓢(ℝ,ℂ)) :
    inner ℝ (probe K g) v = inner ℝ (image K g) u

theorem closed_pairing (K : 𝓢(ℝ,ℝ)) (u : (closedDerivative K).domain) (g : 𝓢(ℝ,ℂ)) :
    inner ℝ (probe K g) (closedDerivative K u) = inner ℝ (image K g) (u:H K)

theorem probe_in_adjoint_domain (K : 𝓢(ℝ,ℝ)) (g : 𝓢(ℝ,ℂ)) :
    probe K g ∈ (closedDerivative K).adjoint.domain

theorem adjoint_probe_value (K : 𝓢(ℝ,ℝ)) (g : 𝓢(ℝ,ℂ)) :
    (closedDerivative K).adjoint ⟨probe K g, probe_in_adjoint_domain K g⟩ = image K g

theorem probes_span_dense (K : 𝓢(ℝ,ℝ)) :
    Dense (Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range (probe K)) : Set (H K))

theorem adjoint_dense_domain (K : 𝓢(ℝ,ℝ)) :
    Dense ((closedDerivative K).adjoint.domain : Set (H K))
theorem derivative_bidual (K : 𝓢(ℝ,ℝ)) : (closedDerivative K).adjoint.adjoint=closedDerivative K
theorem core_bidual (K : 𝓢(ℝ,ℝ)) : (coreOperator K).adjoint.adjoint=closedDerivative K
theorem sign_square (K : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) (x : ℝ) : sign K x * sign K x = 1
theorem sign_density (K : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) (x : ℝ) : |K x| * sign K x = K x

theorem symmetry_ae (K : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) (u : H K) :
    symmetry K u =ᵐ[measure K] (fun x => sign K x • u x)
theorem symmetry_twice (K : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) (u : H K) : symmetry K (symmetry K u) = u

theorem symmetry_selfadjoint (K : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) (u v : H K) :
    inner ℝ (symmetry K u) v = inner ℝ u (symmetry K v)
theorem symmetry_norm (K : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) (u : H K) : ‖symmetry K u‖ = ‖u‖
theorem symmetry_injective (K : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) : Function.Injective (symmetry K)

theorem form_apply (K : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) (u v : H K) :
    form K u v = inner ℝ (symmetry K u) v
theorem form_symmetric (K : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) (u v : H K) : form K u v = form K v u

theorem form_detects_norm (K : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) (u : H K) :
    form K u (symmetry K u) = ‖u‖^2

theorem form_nondegenerate (K : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) (u : H K)
    (h : ∀ v : H K, form K u v = 0) : u=0

theorem form_core (K : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) (f g : 𝓢(ℝ, ℂ)) :
    form K (coreInput K f) (coreInput K g) =
      ∫ x, sign K x * inner ℝ (f x) (g x) ∂measure K

theorem form_core_density (K : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) (f g : 𝓢(ℝ, ℂ)) :
    form K (coreInput K f) (coreInput K g) = ∫ x : ℝ, K x * inner ℝ (f x) (g x)

theorem graph_mem (K : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) (v w : H K) :
    (v, w) ∈ graph K ↔ (symmetry K v, symmetry K w) ∈ (closedDerivative K).adjoint.graph

theorem graph_singleValued (K : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) (p : H K × H K)
    (hp : p ∈ graph K) (hz : p.1 = 0) : p.2 = 0
theorem divergence_graph (K : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) : (divergence K).graph = graph K
theorem divergence_closed (K : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) : (divergence K).IsClosed

theorem divergence_domain (K : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) (v : H K) :
    v ∈ (divergence K).domain ↔ symmetry K v ∈ (closedDerivative K).adjoint.domain

theorem divergence_pairing (K : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) (v w : H K) :
    (v, w) ∈ (divergence K).graph ↔ ∀ u : (closedDerivative K).domain,
      form K (closedDerivative K u) v = form K (u : H K) w

theorem divergence_apply (K : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) (v : (divergence K).domain) :
    divergence K v = symmetry K ((closedDerivative K).adjoint
      ⟨symmetry K (v : H K), (divergence_domain K _).mp v.property⟩)

theorem divergence_dense_domain (K : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) :
    Dense ((divergence K).domain : Set (H K))

theorem resolvent_domain (K : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) (x : H K) :
    resolvent K x ∈ (closedDerivative K).domain

theorem derivative_resolvent (K : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) (x : H K) :
    closedDerivative K ⟨resolvent K x, resolvent_domain K x⟩ = gradient K x

theorem gradient_adjoint_domain (K : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) (x : H K) :
    gradient K x ∈ (closedDerivative K).adjoint.domain

theorem resolvent_equation (K : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) (x : H K) :
    resolvent K x + (closedDerivative K).adjoint
      ⟨gradient K x, gradient_adjoint_domain K x⟩ = x

theorem resolvent_properties (K : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) :
    Function.Injective (resolvent K) ∧ DenseRange (resolvent K) ∧
      (∀ x, ‖resolvent K x‖ ≤ ‖x‖) ∧
      (∀ x y, inner ℝ (resolvent K x) y = inner ℝ x (resolvent K y)) ∧
      (∀ x, 0 ≤ inner ℝ x (resolvent K x))

theorem energy_gap (K : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) (x : H K) (u : (closedDerivative K).domain) :
    ‖x - (u : H K)‖ ^ 2 + ‖closedDerivative K u‖ ^ 2 =
      ‖x - resolvent K x‖ ^ 2 + ‖gradient K x‖ ^ 2 +
        ‖(u : H K) - resolvent K x‖ ^ 2 + ‖closedDerivative K u - gradient K x‖ ^ 2

theorem unique_energy_minimizer (K : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) (x : H K) :
    (∀ u : (closedDerivative K).domain,
      ‖x - resolvent K x‖ ^ 2 + ‖gradient K x‖ ^ 2 ≤
        ‖x - (u : H K)‖ ^ 2 + ‖closedDerivative K u‖ ^ 2) ∧
    (∀ u : (closedDerivative K).domain,
      ‖x - (u : H K)‖ ^ 2 + ‖closedDerivative K u‖ ^ 2 ≤
        ‖x - resolvent K x‖ ^ 2 + ‖gradient K x‖ ^ 2 →
          (u : H K) = resolvent K x)

theorem distributional_equation (K : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) (x : H K) :
    embed K (gradient K x) =
      TemperedDistribution.derivCLM ℂ (embed K (resolvent K x)) -
        driftEmbedding K (resolvent K x)

theorem adjoint_probe_identity (K : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) (x : H K) (g : 𝓢(ℝ, ℂ)) :
    inner ℝ (SignedSchwartzAdjointProbes.probe K g) (gradient K x) =
      inner ℝ (SignedSchwartzAdjointProbes.image K g) (resolvent K x)

theorem higherHeatResolvent_injective_dense (m : ℕ) (hm : 0 < m) (t : ℝ≥0) (ht : 0 < t) :
    Function.Injective (higherHeatResolvent m hm t ht) ∧
      DenseRange (higherHeatResolvent m hm t ht)

theorem operator_properties (K : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) :
    Dense ((operator K).domain : Set (H K)) ∧ (operator K).IsClosed ∧
      IsSelfAdjoint (operator K) ∧
      (∀ u : (operator K).domain, 0 ≤ inner ℝ (operator K u) (u:H K))

theorem graph_factorization (K : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) (u w : H K) :
    (u,w) ∈ (operator K).graph ↔
      ∃ v : H K, (u,v) ∈ (closedDerivative K).graph ∧
        (v,w) ∈ (closedDerivative K).adjoint.graph

theorem resolvent_domain (K : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) (x : H K) :
    SignedSchwartzEnergyResolvent.resolvent K x ∈ (operator K).domain

theorem resolvent_value (K : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) (x : H K) :
    operator K ⟨SignedSchwartzEnergyResolvent.resolvent K x, resolvent_domain K x⟩ =
      x-SignedSchwartzEnergyResolvent.resolvent K x

theorem resolvent_surjective (K : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) (x : H K) :
    ∃ u : (operator K).domain, (u:H K)+operator K u=x

theorem weighted_distributional_factorization (K : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) (u w : H K)
    (h : (u,w) ∈ (operator K).graph) :
    ∃ v : H K,
      embed K v = TemperedDistribution.derivCLM ℂ (embed K u) - driftEmbedding K u ∧
        (v,w) ∈ (closedDerivative K).adjoint.graph

theorem higherHeatOperator_selfAdjoint (m : ℕ) (hm : 0 < m) (t : ℝ≥0) (ht : 0 < t) :
    IsSelfAdjoint (higherHeatOperator m hm t ht)

theorem counterexample_operator :
    IsSelfAdjoint (operator NormalizedSignedScoreCounterexample.normalized) ∧
      ¬ MemLp (fun x : ℝ => (SignedSchwartzLogDerivative.score
        NormalizedSignedScoreCounterexample.normalized x:ℂ)) 2
        (measure NormalizedSignedScoreCounterexample.normalized)

theorem pair_mem_graph (T : E →ₗ.[ℝ] F) (hT : T.IsClosed) (x : E) :
    (resolvent T hT x, gradient T hT x) ∈ T.graph

theorem weak_identity (T : E →ₗ.[ℝ] F) (hT : T.IsClosed) (x : E) (u : T.domain) :
    inner ℝ (resolvent T hT x) (u : E) + inner ℝ (gradient T hT x) (T u) =
      inner ℝ x (u : E)

theorem gradient_mem_adjoint (T : E →ₗ.[ℝ] F) (hT : T.IsClosed) (x : E) :
    gradient T hT x ∈ T.adjoint.domain

theorem adjoint_gradient (T : E →ₗ.[ℝ] F) (hT : T.IsClosed)
    (hd : Dense (T.domain : Set E)) (x : E) :
    T.adjoint ⟨gradient T hT x, gradient_mem_adjoint T hT x⟩ = x - resolvent T hT x

theorem energy_identity (T : E →ₗ.[ℝ] F) (hT : T.IsClosed) (x : E) :
    ‖resolvent T hT x‖ ^ 2 + ‖gradient T hT x‖ ^ 2 = inner ℝ x (resolvent T hT x)

theorem resolvent_contraction (T : E →ₗ.[ℝ] F) (hT : T.IsClosed) (x : E) :
    ‖resolvent T hT x‖ ≤ ‖x‖

theorem resolvent_symmetric (T : E →ₗ.[ℝ] F) (hT : T.IsClosed) (x y : E) :
    inner ℝ (resolvent T hT x) y = inner ℝ x (resolvent T hT y)

theorem resolvent_positive (T : E →ₗ.[ℝ] F) (hT : T.IsClosed) (x : E) :
    0 ≤ inner ℝ x (resolvent T hT x)

theorem resolvent_injective (T : E →ₗ.[ℝ] F) (hT : T.IsClosed)
    (hd : Dense (T.domain : Set E)) : Function.Injective (resolvent T hT)

theorem resolvent_dense_range (T : E →ₗ.[ℝ] F) (hT : T.IsClosed)
    (hd : Dense (T.domain : Set E)) : DenseRange (resolvent T hT)

theorem energy_gap (T : E →ₗ.[ℝ] F) (hT : T.IsClosed) (x : E) (u : T.domain) :
    ‖x - (u : E)‖ ^ 2 + ‖T u‖ ^ 2 =
      ‖x - resolvent T hT x‖ ^ 2 + ‖gradient T hT x‖ ^ 2 +
        ‖(u : E) - resolvent T hT x‖ ^ 2 + ‖T u - gradient T hT x‖ ^ 2

theorem energy_minimum_unique (T : E →ₗ.[ℝ] F) (hT : T.IsClosed) (x : E) (u : T.domain)
    (hu : ‖x - (u : E)‖ ^ 2 + ‖T u‖ ^ 2 ≤
      ‖x - resolvent T hT x‖ ^ 2 + ‖gradient T hT x‖ ^ 2) :
    (u : E) = resolvent T hT x

theorem energy_adjoint_eq (T : E →ₗ.[ℝ] F) (hT : T.IsClosed)
    (hd : Dense (T.domain : Set E)) : (energyOperator T hT).adjoint=energyOperator T hT

theorem energy_selfAdjoint (T : E →ₗ.[ℝ] F) (hT : T.IsClosed)
    (hd : Dense (T.domain : Set E)) : IsSelfAdjoint (energyOperator T hT)

theorem energy_resolvent_surjective (T : E →ₗ.[ℝ] F) (hT : T.IsClosed)
    (hd : Dense (T.domain : Set E)) (x : E) :
    ∃ u : (energyOperator T hT).domain, (u:E)+energyOperator T hT u=x

theorem energy_closed (T : E →ₗ.[ℝ] F) (hT : T.IsClosed)
    (hd : Dense (T.domain : Set E)) : (energyOperator T hT).IsClosed

theorem energy_nonnegative (T : E →ₗ.[ℝ] F) (hT : T.IsClosed)
    (hd : Dense (T.domain : Set E)) (u : (energyOperator T hT).domain) :
    0 ≤ inner ℝ (energyOperator T hT u) (u:E)

theorem energy_graph_factorization (T : E →ₗ.[ℝ] F) (hT : T.IsClosed)
    (hd : Dense (T.domain : Set E)) (u w : E) :
    (u,w) ∈ (energyOperator T hT).graph ↔
      ∃ v : F, (u,v) ∈ T.graph ∧ (v,w) ∈ T.adjoint.graph

theorem transverse_zeros_countable (f f' : ℝ → ℝ)
    (hf : ∀ x, HasDerivAt f (f' x) x) : {x | f x=0 ∧ f' x≠0}.Countable

theorem derivative_zero_on_zero_ae (f f' : ℝ → ℝ)
    (hf : ∀ x, HasDerivAt f (f' x) x) : ∀ᵐ x : ℝ, f x=0 → f' x=0

theorem logarithmic_cancel_ae (f f' : ℝ → ℝ)
    (hf : ∀ x, HasDerivAt f (f' x) x) :
    (fun x => f x * (-(f' x)/f x)) =ᵐ[volume] (fun x => -(f' x))
theorem score_measurable (K : 𝓢(ℝ,ℝ)) : Measurable (score K)

theorem score_cancel (K : 𝓢(ℝ,ℝ)) :
    (fun x : ℝ => K x * score K x) =ᵐ[volume] (fun x => -(deriv K x))

theorem score_absolute_integrable (K : 𝓢(ℝ,ℝ)) :
    Integrable (fun x : ℝ => (score K x : ℂ)) (absoluteDensity volume K)

theorem score_l1_norm (K : 𝓢(ℝ,ℝ)) :
    (∫ x : ℝ, ‖(score K x:ℂ)‖ ∂absoluteDensity volume K) =
      (∫ x : ℝ, |deriv K x|)

theorem real_stein (K g : 𝓢(ℝ,ℝ)) :
    (∫ x : ℝ, deriv g x*K x) = (∫ x : ℝ, g x*score K x*K x)

theorem complex_stein (K : 𝓢(ℝ,ℝ)) (g : 𝓢(ℝ,ℂ)) :
    (∫ x : ℝ, K x • deriv g x) =
      (∫ x : ℝ, K x • ((score K x:ℂ)*g x))

theorem signed_stein (K : 𝓢(ℝ,ℝ)) (g : 𝓢(ℝ,ℂ)) :
    (∫ᵛ x : ℝ, deriv g x ∂<•volume.withDensityᵥ (K:ℝ → ℝ)) =
      (∫ᵛ x : ℝ, (score K x:ℂ)*g x ∂<•volume.withDensityᵥ (K:ℝ → ℝ))

theorem higher_heat_signed_stein (m : ℕ) (hm : 0 < m) (t : ℝ≥0) (ht : 0 < t)
    (g : 𝓢(ℝ,ℂ)) :
    (∫ᵛ x : ℝ, deriv g x ∂<•HigherHeatSignedLaws.law m hm t ht) =
      (∫ᵛ x : ℝ, (score (HigherHeatSignedLaws.realKernel m hm t ht) x:ℂ)*g x
        ∂<•HigherHeatSignedLaws.law m hm t ht)

theorem higher_heat_score_not_polynomial (m : ℕ) (hm : 2 ≤ m)
    (t : ℝ≥0) (ht : 0 < t) :
    ¬ ∃ W : Polynomial ℝ, ∀ x : ℝ,
      score (HigherHeatSignedLaws.realKernel m (by omega) t ht) x = W.eval x

theorem local_bounds (K : 𝓢(ℝ,ℝ)) (hz : K 0=0) (hd : deriv K 0≠0) :
    ∃ C > 0, ∃ c > 0, ∃ δ > 0, ∀ x ∈ Ioo (0:ℝ) δ,
      |K x| ≤ C*x ∧ K x≠0 ∧ c ≤ |deriv K x|

theorem fisher_not_integrable (K : 𝓢(ℝ,ℝ)) (hz : K 0=0) (hd : deriv K 0≠0) :
    ¬ Integrable (fun x : ℝ => (deriv K x)^2 / |K x|)

theorem score_not_memLp_two (K : 𝓢(ℝ,ℝ)) (hz : K 0=0) (hd : deriv K 0≠0) :
    ¬ MemLp (fun x : ℝ => (score K x:ℂ)) 2 (absoluteDensity volume K)
theorem odd_apply (x : ℝ) : oddPart x=x*Real.exp (-x^2)
theorem even_apply (x : ℝ) : evenPart x=x^2*Real.exp (-x^2)
theorem raw_apply (x : ℝ) : raw x=(x+x^2)*Real.exp (-x^2)
theorem odd_integral : (∫ x : ℝ, oddPart x)=0
theorem even_integral_positive : 0 < (∫ x : ℝ, evenPart x)
theorem mass_positive : 0 < mass
theorem raw_zero : raw 0=0
theorem raw_derivative : deriv raw 0=1
theorem normalized_mass : (∫ x : ℝ, normalized x)=1
theorem normalized_zero : normalized 0=0
theorem normalized_derivative : deriv normalized 0=mass⁻¹
theorem normalized_negative : normalized (-(1:ℝ)/2) < 0
theorem law_mass : law Set.univ=1

theorem counterexample :
    ∃ K : 𝓢(ℝ,ℝ), (∫ x : ℝ, K x)=1 ∧ K (-(1:ℝ)/2)<0 ∧
      Integrable (fun x : ℝ => (score K x:ℂ)) (absoluteDensity volume K) ∧
      ¬ MemLp (fun x : ℝ => (score K x:ℂ)) 2 (absoluteDensity volume K)

theorem residual_apply (K : 𝓢(ℝ,ℝ)) (W : Polynomial ℝ) (x : ℝ) :
    residual K W x=deriv K x+W.eval x*K x

theorem residual_ae_zero (K : 𝓢(ℝ,ℝ)) (W : Polynomial ℝ)
    (h : ∀ g : 𝓢(ℝ,ℝ), (∫ x : ℝ, deriv g x*K x)=(∫ x : ℝ, g x*W.eval x*K x)) :
    (residual K W : ℝ → ℝ)=ᵐ[volume] 0

theorem kernel_ode (K : 𝓢(ℝ,ℝ)) (W : Polynomial ℝ)
    (h : ∀ g : 𝓢(ℝ,ℝ), (∫ x : ℝ, deriv g x*K x)=(∫ x : ℝ, g x*W.eval x*K x)) (x : ℝ) :
    deriv K x= -W.eval x*K x
theorem primitive_hasDerivAt (W : Polynomial ℝ) (x : ℝ) : HasDerivAt (primitive W) (W.eval x) x

theorem factor_hasDerivAt_zero (K : 𝓢(ℝ,ℝ)) (W : Polynomial ℝ)
    (h : ∀ g : 𝓢(ℝ,ℝ), (∫ x : ℝ, deriv g x*K x)=(∫ x : ℝ, g x*W.eval x*K x)) (x : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (integratingFactor K W) 0 x

theorem factor_constant (K : 𝓢(ℝ,ℝ)) (W : Polynomial ℝ)
    (h : ∀ g : 𝓢(ℝ,ℝ), (∫ x : ℝ, deriv g x*K x)=(∫ x : ℝ, g x*W.eval x*K x)) (x y : ℝ) :
    integratingFactor K W x=integratingFactor K W y

theorem no_opposite_signs (K : 𝓢(ℝ,ℝ)) (W : Polynomial ℝ)
    (h : ∀ g : 𝓢(ℝ,ℝ), (∫ x : ℝ, deriv g x*K x)=(∫ x : ℝ, g x*W.eval x*K x)) (x y : ℝ) :
    ¬ (K x < 0 ∧ 0 < K y)

theorem nonnegative_of_positive_mass (K : 𝓢(ℝ,ℝ)) (hmass : 0 < ∫ x : ℝ, K x) (W : Polynomial ℝ)
    (h : ∀ g : 𝓢(ℝ,ℝ), (∫ x : ℝ, deriv g x*K x)=(∫ x : ℝ, g x*W.eval x*K x)) : ∀ x, 0 ≤ K x

theorem higher_heat_no_first_order_polynomial_weight (m : ℕ) (hm : 2 ≤ m) (t : ℝ≥0) (ht : 0 < t) :
    ¬ ∃ W : Polynomial ℝ, ∀ g : 𝓢(ℝ,ℝ),
      (∫ x : ℝ, deriv g x*realKernel m (by omega) t ht x)=
        (∫ x : ℝ, g x*W.eval x*realKernel m (by omega) t ht x)

theorem realKernel_integral (m : ℕ) (hm : 0 < m) (t : ℝ≥0) (ht : 0 < t) :
    ∫ x, realKernel m hm t ht x = 1

theorem real_second_moment (m : ℕ) (hm : 2 ≤ m) (t : ℝ≥0) (ht : 0 < t) :
    ∫ x : ℝ, x^2 * realKernel m (by omega) t ht x = 0

theorem not_nonnegative_ae (m : ℕ) (hm : 2 ≤ m) (t : ℝ≥0) (ht : 0 < t) :
    ¬ ∀ᵐ x : ℝ ∂volume, 0 ≤ realKernel m (by omega) t ht x

theorem exists_negative (m : ℕ) (hm : 2 ≤ m) (t : ℝ≥0) (ht : 0 < t) :
    ∃ x : ℝ, realKernel m (by omega) t ht x < 0

The actual distributional embedding has density u*K^2 against Lebesgue measure, with bounded drift 2*sign(K)*Kprime against absolute density. It is not the potentially undefined unweighted distribution represented by u.

The core derivative is first shown representative independent through the weak graph. Its original graph closure is included in the closed weak derivative; equality is not asserted. Dense Schwartz inputs are justified by finite Radon regularity and mollification.

The explicit coordinate probes w*conjugate(phi) and -w*conjugate(phi-prime)-b*conjugate(phi) are human Riesz-coordinate deductions proved by their pairings. They are total in H, not claimed to be a graph core for the adjoint.
The exact signed-adjoint domain is sign-transport of the Hilbert adjoint domain. The positive energy uses the Hilbert adjoint Dstar D rather than the signed divergence.

The complete Hilbert energy proof regroups actual closed-graph projection, weak variational identity, full product domain and resolvent-range argument. Positive quadratic form is not positivity preservation or an identified Markov generator.

The residual-squared test gives a shorter human proof of the actual polynomial Stein ODE. The normalized explicit signed example has a simple zero and L1 but non-L2 score. No simple-zero or non-L2-score assertion is made for every higher-heat kernel.
Hamza and fundamental-symmetry mechanisms are classical antecedents. Bounded-interval weighted relaxation and Krein coupling/spectral theorems are not transferred to the original global graph.
